comparisonMethod: Compare the quoted fragments, in order, and the displayed mathematics after ordinary font, spacing and plain-text index rendering. Explicit ellipses may omit intervening text. Outside-quotation connecting commentary is not certified as literal source wording; its specified displays were inspected separately. Changing a superscript to a subscript is not silently normalised: see E15.
provenanceNote: The batch readFrom label says preprint, whereas all twelve locators and the current input record describe published-version readings. This session independently checked the published copy. The failed arXiv v1 fetch is not recorded as a reading, and no preprint-to-print revision is inferred from the batch label.
mathematicalScope: Quotation collation only. No sourceIssue correction, reason, mathematical review verdict or newness claim was changed or independently certified. A passage being present does not by itself prove that the passage is mathematically wrong.
